tagline: Global Power Generation and Distribution Leader
hero_kpi_rationale: Capex reflects strategic commitment to renewable energy and critical infrastructure, a driver of structural growth for the energy sector.

ai_positioning.summary: AES uses AI internally to improve its processes and offers intelligent energy solutions through its subsidiary Fluence, but does not appear to develop its own AI models at large scale.
evidence: In 2025, AES furthered its partnership with the AI Fund to combine its power sector expertise with the fund's artificial intelligence capabilities, leveraging generative AI technology to address bottlenecks in the energy transition.
AES made significant advancements with Maximo, an AI-powered robot designed to enhance the speed, efficiency, and safety of solar installations.
Fluence, created in 2018 as a joint venture by AES and Siemens AG, is a leading global provider of energy storage and services and AI-enabled digital applications for renewables and storage.

kpis.description: R&D expenses remain low but targeted on the efficiency of solar and storage projects.

kpis.description: G&A expenses dropped sharply in 2025 to $241M, driven by savings on IT costs ($18M), business development expenses ($34M) and professional fees ($8M), partially offset by $14M in one-time restructuring costs.

company_description: The AES Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a power generation and utility company. It operates through four segments: Renewables, Utilities, Energy Infrastructure, and New Energy Technologies. The company owns and/or operates power plants to generate and sell power to customers, such as utilities, industrial users, and other intermediaries; owns and/or operates utilities to generate or purchase, distribute, transmit, and sell electricity to end-user customers in the residential, commercial, industrial, and governmental sectors; and generates and sells electricity on the wholesale market, as well as investments in technologies to support leading-edge greener energy solutions. It uses various fuels and technologies to generate electricity, such as solar, hydro, wind, coal, and gas, as well as renewables comprising energy storage and landfill gas. The company owns and/or operates a generation portfolio of approximately 34,740 megawatts and distributes power to 2.7 million customers.
